tasks.prompt: Warm-up: say 事 (si6, low flat tone 低平调) three times in a row. Low and flat, not mid like 試 si3, not falling like 時 si4.
tasks.script: 事 si6 · 事 si6 · 事 si6 (試 si3 is mid; 時 si4 falls; 事 si6 sits low and flat)

tasks.title: Optional: BBC 6 Minute English “Are microplastics harming us?” (~6 min). Skip if short on time.

tasks.prompt: Workplace output, 30–60 sec: mid-week daily update. “Here's where I am today, and what I'll finish this afternoon.” Point → reason → example. Say it aloud before opening the script.
tasks.script:
Point: Here's my mid-week update: I'll finish the current task this afternoon and send a short note by the end of the day.
Reason: I want you to have a clear picture of where things stand before tomorrow.
Example: This morning I'm checking the numbers; if anything looks off, I'll flag it early rather than wait.

tasks.title: Read / shadow the 3 new workplace lines (Hub Play may be silent — use the chat audio)

tasks.prompt: Shadow the 3 new lines ×3 (use the chat audio; Hub Play may be silent), then say them without the script. Then a 1-minute take: point → reason → example. Point: tell a colleague you will confirm and finish it today. Reason: so they can plan. Example: offer to be found anytime.
